subject: Mobile Development
title: App Review Guidelines
description: A micro-lesson that makes App Review Guidelines usable.

hook.text: Apple's App Review Guidelines run over 30 pages. One wrong step means rejection.

buildup.text: Rules cover content, privacy, monetization, performance, and even UI design standards.

discovery.text: Apps that mimic system UI, crash on launch, or use private APIs are automatically rejected.

twist.text: The guidelines change frequently. An app approved last month can be rejected today.

climax.text: The review process maintains quality but gives Apple enormous power over developers.

punchline.text: Apple's rules shape what apps can exist.

quiz.question: What happens if an app uses private APIs?
options: It gets featured in the store
